ORDER NO. 28604 

On November 13, 2000, Avista Corporation dba Avista Utilities—Washington Water 
Power Division (Idaho) made a filing with the Idaho Public Utilities Commission (Commission) 
requesting authority to add a new Section 6.3 to the Company’s Idaho Rules and Regulations: 
i.e., 
6.3 Service Establishment Charge 
When an account is initially established under any of the Rules and 
Regulations, a Customer will be required to pay a service establishment 
charge in the amount of $15.00. 

The Company requests an effective implementation date of December 22, 2000. 
The Commission finds it reasonable to process the Company’s Application in Case 
Nos. AVU-G-00-6 and AVU-E-00-11 under Modified Procedure, i.e., by written submission 
rather than by hearing. Reference Commission Rules of Procedure, IDAPA 31.01.01.201-204. 
To facilitate the processing of the Application under Modified Procedure and to accommodate 
the Commission’s scheduling constraints, the Commission finds that it is necessary to suspend 
the proposed effective date from December 22, 2000 to Friday, January 26, 2001. Reference 
IDAPA 31.01.01.134.02. 
O R D E R 

In consideration of the foregoing and pending further Commission Order, IT IS 
HEREBY ORDERED and the Commission does hereby suspend the proposed effective date for 
the proposed service establishment charge in Case Nos. AVU-G-00-6 and AVU-E-00-11 from 
December 22, 2000 to January 26, 2001.
